user.title: Add HomeNodes
user.description: HomeNodes adds a panel for administrators that draws every automation and script as a live node graph. It reads your configuration and history; nothing leaves Home Assistant.

abort.single_instance_allowed: HomeNodes is already set up. Change its options instead.

init.title: HomeNodes options
init.description: To rename the panel, change its icon or hide it, edit the sidebar itself.

data.hidden_labels: Labels to leave off the map

data_description.controls: Show buttons to run, enable and disable automations and scripts, and dots that switch lights, switches, fans and toggle helpers. Off by default, so panning the map on a phone can't change anything.
data_description.default_grouping: Used until someone picks a grouping from the panel's View menu.
data_description.heat_days: How far back activity heat counts runs.
data_description.hidden_labels: Automations and scripts with any of these labels are not drawn or read.
